verdict.rationale: Termius is a terminal client with a built-in Local terminal and SSH/Mosh sessions (termius-docs-35). Users report running full-screen TUI apps like mutt and debugging and deploying fixes from inside it (termius-comm-6, termius-comm-2), which implies terminal-based tools can run in-app, but no evidence names text editors or linters. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on reports of editing files with vim/nano/emacs in Termius, evidence of running syntax/lint checkers, details on editor-relevant terminal emulation (key handling, Esc/Meta support)
